objective: Audit and remediate all Procore endpoint structured projections so all primary and nested fields from full raw payloads are projected into useful raw/structured content tables.
non_negotiable_completion_gate: No endpoint/table is complete until every primary and nested field observed in full raw payloads is projected into an endpoint-specific table, child table, dimension table, or documented lossless JSON sidecar; unmapped business-field count must be zero.
source_findings: PR #18 made full raw Procore payloads available in procore_endpoint_raw_payloads.
Change-events proof showed live_full_payload rows exist but many structured columns remain empty.

Nested change-event payloads contain change_items, attachments, markup_items, production_quantities, custom_fields, company_id, project_id, change_type, change_reason, scope, and other business fields not captured by the generic procore_raw_change_events table.
